Popup

Introduction

The popup layer container provides popups and messages. Multiple popup layers can be stacked.

Sample Code

1. Basic usage

Use the show attribute to determine whether to display the popup layer.

<button title="show popup layer" is-link bind:click="showPopup" /&gt";

<maui-popup show="{{ show }}" bind:close="onClose">content </maui-popup>
Page({ data: { show: false, }, showPopup() { this.setData({ show: true }); }, onClose() { this.setData({ show: false });
}, });

2. Popup Position

Use the position attribute to set the popup position. By default, the popup is centered. You can set it to top, bottom, left, or right.

<maui-popup show="{{ show }}" position="top" custom-style="height: 20%;" bind:close="onClose" />

3. Close icon

Setting the closeable attribute displays the close icon in the upper right corner of the popup layer. You can set the close-icon attribute to customize the icon and set the close-icon-position attribute to customize the icon position.

<maui-popup show="{{ show }}" closeable position="bottom" custom-style="height: 20%" bind:close="onClose" />

<!-- custom icon -->
<maui-popup
  show="{{ show }}"
  closeable
  close-icon="close"
  position="bottom"
  custom-style="height: 20%"
  bind:close="onClose"
/>

<!-- icon position -->
<maui-popup
  show="{{ show }}"
  closeable
  close-icon-position="top-left"
  position="bottom"
  custom-style="height: 20%"
  bind:close="onClose"
/>

4. Round corner popup window

Setting the round attribute adds different round corner styles to the popup window based on the popup position.

<maui-popup show="{{ show }}" round position="bottom" custom-style="height: 20%" bind:close="onClose" />

5. Scroll penetration forbidden

If you continue to slide content to the end of a component, the underlying page will be scrolled. This is called scroll penetration.

Setting the lock-scroll attribute of the component can resolve some of the scroll penetration problems, but due to Mini Program's own reasons, scroll penetration still occurs in the content area of a popup window. The following solution is recommended to solve all the scroll penetration problems:

page-meta

<!-- page-meta must be the first node on the page -->
<page-meta page-style="{{ show ? 'overflow: hidden;' : '' }}" />

<maui-popup show="{{ show }}" catch:touchstart />

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
show Whether to display the popup layer. Boolean false
z-index z-index level. Number 100
overlay Whether to display the mask layer. Boolean true
position Popup position. The options are top, bottom, right, and left. String center
duration Animation duration, in milliseconds. Number 300
round Whether to display round corners. Boolean false
custom-style Custom popup layer style. String ''
overlay-style Custom mask layer style. String ''
close-on-click-overlay Whether to close the mask layer by clicking it. Boolean true
closeable Whether to display the close icon. Boolean false
close-icon Close icon name or image URL. String cancel

Events

Event Description Parameter
bind:close Triggered when closing the popup layer. -
bind:click-overlay Triggered when clicking the mask layer. -
bind:before-enter Triggered before the entry. -
bind:enter Triggered during the entry. -
bind:after-enter Triggered after the entry. -
bind:before-leave Triggered before the exit. -
bind:leave Triggered during the exit. -
bind:after-leave Triggered after the exit. -
